description: A progressive web app is a website that can add useful app features. It may offer an install option or an offline page. Learn how a manifest and a service worker help, without assuming every browser behaves the same. These examples belong in separate files on your own HTTPS or localhost site. Service workers need that trusted origin and cannot run in this site's sandbox. Use browser developer tools to inspect them.
versionNote: Uses the Web App Manifest, Service Worker and Cache Storage standards.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to choose a short app name that fits under an icon
Learn to create offline.html with a short offline message
Learn to inspect active and waiting workers after changing sw.js
